title: Polished Crystal (gen2_polished) release candidate — the SOLO lane
rationale: tools/verify_gen2_release.py is the Gen 2 release manifest and must not change: tests/unit/test_polished_release_guards.py pins its TITLES to (crystal, gold, silver) and its DUO_PAIRS to vanilla pairings. That is right — Polished Crystal is a SOLO title with no vanilla partner, so it has no duo matrix, no second fixture and no per-title live-gate set to extend. This manifest is the separate lane: one row per obligation, judged by tools/verify_polished_release.py.

kinds.SOURCE: a generator's own --check: the committed artifact must equal what the pinned source re-derives
kinds.BUILD: a reproducible build that must reproduce published bytes
kinds.MODEL: named unit files, one pytest subprocess per file; no emulator
kinds.LIVE: a committed receipt transcribing an emulator run already on disk; this machine has none
kinds.MANAGER: an import and an assertion against the live server modules
kinds.RELEASE: the shipped player ZIP and the zip hygiene gate
kinds.OPEN: work other cards are still building; red until closed with an author

live_receipt_rules.grade: Every receipt is DEV. A lane author cannot promote their own run to PHYSICAL; that is an owner act recorded elsewhere.
live_receipt_rules.rom_binding: rom_sha1_executed must equal data/polished/overlay_provenance.json's output.sha1 today. The phone-card commit moved the overlay 29ea04c2 -> 34942315, so every earlier receipt is STALE and red until re-run.
live_receipt_rules.evidence_bytes: evidence_file is hashed at judge time. A mismatch is tampering; an unreachable file is also red — a transcription nobody can check is not evidence. Run this on the lane host.
live_receipt_rules.code_digest: UNRECORDED where the lane evidence did not print one. The narrative docs/polished/LIVE_RESULTS.md names commits; the evidence files do not, so the receipts carry UNRECORDED and not the doc's claim.
